									<p>At the heart of the platform sits our digitalAudience identity graph — the layer that turns fragmented first-party records into addressable audiences for each market, globally. Where cookies fade, our graphs resolve who a person is across email, mobile, hashed identifiers and connected TV signals, market by market.</p><p>AI sharpens the picture. Machine learning strengthens the signals that feed the graph — filtering noise, weighting confidence, and surfacing the connections that matter. The result is a graph that keeps learning, so the audiences you activate today are more precise than the ones you activated last quarter.</p><p>Designed in Europe, works globally. Local depth in Netherlands, Sweden, Germany Belgium, Finland and the United Kingdom. Hosting available on AWS in the US and Germany, governed to EU standards.</p>								</div>
